text:
Aisha (CS): Heads-up: multiple EU onboarding jobs stuck at \"indexing\" and some 502s reported since ~02:05 UTC. Saw in both trial and paid customers.
Jon (SRE): Logged: high retry rates on ingress -> upstream timeout to KV cache cluster eu-kv-01 starting 02:03 UTC.
Renee (Eng): Confirmed. A routing update rolled at 02:00 caused health-check flaps for some KV replicas. Requests piled up and caused transient 502s.
Aisha (CS): Which accounts are affected? any upcoming renewals or exec touches?
Caleb (CS Lead): I've flagged 4 renewal-risk customers and 3 pilots. Tara, can you prep account notes once we have a short comm?
Tara (AM): On it. Please include exec contact lines and an optional live walkthrough link.
Jon (SRE): Mitigation: rolling revert of routing update + isolate traffic to healthy replicas. Starting now, ETA ~12m.
Renee (Eng): For non-VPC customers we can temporarily reroute to fallback pool; for VPC customers we must queue safe reingest once KV is healthy.
Aisha (CS): Important: VPC customers need explicit mention. Also please add reassurance re: data exposure.
Jon (SRE): No data exfil; just transient failures. Add \"no data was exposed\" to customer note.
Caleb (CS Lead): Keep comm short: impact, what we did, ETA, next steps, contact. Also offer a one-time credit.
Aisha (CS): Draft below for review.
Aisha (CS): ```
Hi <Customer Team>,
Short update: we experienced a network/routing issue affecting EU dedicated onboarding pools beginning 02:03 UTC, which caused some indexing jobs to stall and occasional 502s.
What we did: reverted the routing change and routed non-VPC onboarding to a fallback pool; VPC accounts will receive a prioritized, safe reingest once our KV layer finishes resync.
ETA: prioritized completions expected within 30	60 minutes.
Security: no customer data was exposed.
Next steps: we'll confirm when indexing completes and are offering a one-time credit for the disruption. For urgent concerns, reply to this thread or book a 1:1: <link>.
Thanks,
Aisha on behalf of Redwood Inference Ops
```
Jon (SRE): +1. Add a line about monitoring and a follow-up RCA with timelines (initial within 24h, full in 72h).
Aisha (CS): Added. Sending to Tara for account personalization.
Tara (AM): I'll tailor and send to the flagged accounts; ping me the final impacted list.
ops-bot: Requeue job started at 02:18 UTC. Will post impacted tenants when complete. (automated) :gear:
Renee (Eng): Postmortem note: preliminary root cause is a bad routing rollout combined with insufficient replica health-check grace period. We'll include mitigation steps in RCA.
Jon (SRE): KV resync finished at 02:26 UTC. Requeue progressing; watching throughput.
ops-bot: Requeue completed at 02:30 UTC. Impacted tenants: tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-alpha, tenant-omega, tenant-prime. (automated)
Aisha (CS): Thanks. Sending comms now starting with the renewal-risk accounts. Pastes the sent note for the audit log.
Caleb (CS Lead): Please CC CS leads and BCC exec sponsor. Also create an office hours invite for tomorrow for any customers wanting a walkthrough.
Tara (AM): Sent to tenant-77 and tenant-prime with exec contact lines. AMs are looping in customers.
Renee (Eng): We'll share the initial RCA within 24h and proposed infra changes (stricter health-checks + canary window for routing rollouts).
Aisha (CS): Closing customer ops task after all affected accounts confirm receipt. Will keep this thread updated until RCA posts.
Caleb (CS Lead): Thanks team. Good coordination.
